How to Kick Players on a Clone Hero Server - BisectHosting

notes: Clone Hero does ship an official standalone (headless) server, downloadable from clonehero.net and used by the hosting providers, but it exposes NO command channel to the server operator: no RCON, no admin HTTP API, and no stdin command loop. The executable prompts for configuration on first run and thereafter reads settings.ini (server name, port - default UDP 14242 - password, defaultgamemode, minrequiredplayers, maxplayers, maxspectators, servertickrate, lowsongspeed, maxsongspeed); after startup the console only prints logs. All moderation is done IN-GAME by the lobby host/leader (the first player to join), typed into lobby chat with a backslash prefix: '\kick all', '\kick players', '\kick spectators', '\kick player #' (1-4), plus '\setpass', '\setsongcount', '\setmaxspeed', '\setlowspeed', and '\help' for the full list. Those are client-side chat commands from a seated player, not something a server manager can send down a pipe, so they are not recorded as commands here. There is also no ban system and no server-side player roster query - the operator's only levers are settings.ini (password, max players) plus restarting the process, so RIFT//CTRL should fall through to the host-level floor. Confidence is 'low' because this is an argument from absence: the Clone Hero wiki, the Docker packaging of the server and two hosting knowledge bases all document configuration and in-game chat commands and none mentions a server console, but no source states outright that a console does not exist.
